text: Ben maɓɓe Yaaquuba maakani ɓe: Wanaa non woniri. Ko woni goonga, ko wonnde wonkiiji mon ɗin cuɗanii on fewjangol mo wano fewjirannoɗon neene-gooto makko on Yuusufa aranun. Mi muññorii no labiraa, ko aldaa e wullitagol si wanaa e Alla. Hino hasii ka Alla artiranta mi ɓe, ɓe fow maɓɓe: Yuusufu e neene-gooto makko mun on e kotoo maɓɓe mawɗo on. Pellet Kanko Seniiɗo On, ko O Annduɗo fiyaaku am, Ñeeñuɗo e toppitagol fiyaaku am.
